title: ISC — ERP Data Sync (Daily)
description: Runs on a daily Zapier schedule. Calls your ERP REST API, maps the response using Code by Zapier, and POSTs KPI and supplier data to ISC via fetch() inside the Code steps (avoids Zapier JSON serialization issues). Requires a write-scope ISC API key.

settings.note: Runs daily at 02:00 AM in your Zapier account's timezone. Adjust to match your ERP's data availability window.
Replace YOUR_ERP_BASE_URL and REPLACE_WITH_ERP_API_TOKEN. Adjust the 'since' param to match your ERP's API.

This step maps ERP KPI fields AND posts to ISC in one step to avoid Zapier JSON serialization issues. Replace YOUR_ISC_DOMAIN and REPLACE_WITH_ISC_API_KEY (write scope). Adjust item.kpi_code and item.current_value for your ERP.
Fetches the supplier roster from your ERP.

This step maps ERP supplier fields AND posts to ISC in one step. Both 'id' and 'name' are required by ISC. Adjust field names for your ERP. Replace YOUR_ISC_DOMAIN and REPLACE_WITH_ISC_API_KEY (write scope).

setupSteps: 1. In Zapier, create a new Zap. Choose 'Schedule by Zapier → Every Day' as the trigger. Set time to 02:00.
2. Add a 'Webhooks by Zapier → GET' step for your ERP KPI endpoint. Replace YOUR_ERP_BASE_URL and REPLACE_WITH_ERP_API_TOKEN.

3. Add a 'Code by Zapier → Run Javascript' step. Paste the KPI mapping code from step 3 in this file. Replace YOUR_ISC_DOMAIN and REPLACE_WITH_ISC_API_KEY inside the code. Adjust item.kpi_code and item.current_value to match your ERP fields. The Code step posts directly to ISC using fetch().
4. Add another 'Webhooks by Zapier → GET' step for your ERP supplier endpoint.
5. Add another 'Code by Zapier → Run Javascript' step. Paste the supplier mapping code from step 5. Both 'id' and 'name' are required by ISC. The Code step posts directly to ISC using fetch().
6. No ISC webhook registration needed — this Zap is triggered by Zapier's own scheduler.
